name: Crown Bonds
description: Crown debt, pays steady but small dividends. Resistant against even large events.

name: Farmers' Union
description: The Farmers' Union manages the production of staple crops. They have steady and relatively consistent growth.

name: Militia Multinational
description: Militia Multinational manages militia and mercenary work. Their profitability can be volatile, but they gain massive benefits during war.

name: Miners' Association
description: The Miner's Association creates a seady supply of matierals used all across the kingdom. They are relatively consistent with chances for growth.

name: Tinkerers' Partnership
description: The Tinkerers' Partnership produces all sorts of gadgets bot hstaple and novel. Their value can change drastically, but new inventions can greatly increase their evaluation.

name: Raiders Incorporated
description: Raiders incorporated profits most when other companies are doing poorly, typically by stealing their goods.

name: Merchants' Society
description: The Merchants' Society manages trade. They do well in times of peace and are impacted heavily by war.
